tasks.description: Accept the owner-scoped read path and versioned staging publication of one sourced Monstera watering rule.
constraints: Reviewer and QA reports must be in English. Audit the actual committed diff and saved local checks. Model roles are read-only with synthetic fixtures. The controller alone deploys to the documented staging project and performs the live owner read.

This is a read-only recommendation for an owned live plant. Confirm the exact active published taxon and KB release, service-only RPC, provenance and no fallback advice when any required evidence is absent. Verify stable 401/403/404 and private no-store semantics. Existing journal, care automation, diagnosis, provider, quota and billing behavior is outside the write scope.

The v2 artifact contains one conditional check_soil action derived from the stated UW–Madison watering fact, with a null calendar interval. Source attribution, the hash of the retained original evidence note and derived_records scope must match. Polish action text is required by the existing schema and EN is the acceptance language.

Review the explicit staging SQL renderer. It validates the prior release/taxon and existing condition content before atomically activating the new version. The previous pinned condition profile remains readable and the published catalogue is not edited. Local tests do not establish a live profile or iOS result.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production HTTP fixtures prove the exact authored conditional rule and provenance, the null interval and fail-closed behavior; real PostgreSQL fixtures prove owner and published profile selection.
Existing compact v2 schemas, Edge type checks and the actual scoped diff pass.
